items.a: Design, development, translation into your chosen languages, contact form, Google Maps, WhatsApp integration and going live. Hosting on Vercel is included for the first year.

items.q: How long until my website is live?
items.a: For any of our plans, usually less than 24 hours once we have all your information (text, photos, logo).

items.q: Do I need to add maintenance?
items.a: No, maintenance is an optional add-on. We recommend it for security updates and changes without you having to worry about the technical side.

items.q: Can I add a language or switch plans later?
items.a: Yes, any time — we adapt your website as your business grows.
